en.ru: Наша команда создала уникальный алгоритм анализа дневниковых записей, который помогает глубже понимать свои мысли и реакции. Модель обучена на открытых данных и материалах по когнитивно-поведенческой терапии. Вы можете описать ситуацию, которая вызывает у вас переживания, или просто поделиться мыслями в свободной форме. Алгоритм обработает ваш текст и подскажет инсайты, которые помогут лучше понять себя и то, что происходит внутри. Вы можете посмотреть пример анализа, нажав на кнопку ниже. Текст для анализа: Мне кажется, что окружающие видят во мне неудачника. Сегодня на работе я допустил ошибку, и начальник попросил меня исправить её. Его тон показался мне холодным и осуждающим, будто он действительно считает меня неудачником.
en.oldText: Our team has developed a unique journal-analysis algorithm that helps you better understand your thoughts and reactions. The model is trained on open data and materials based on cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT). You can describe a situation that is bothering you or simply share your thoughts in free form. The algorithm will process your text and highlight insights that can help you better understand yourself and what’s going on inside. Tap the button below to see an example of the analysis. Text for analysis: I feel as if people around me see me as a failure. Today at work I made a mistake, and my manager asked me to fix it. His tone felt cold and judgmental, as if he really thinks I’m a failure.
en.newText: Our team has created a unique algorithm to analyze your journal entries, helping you understand your thoughts and reactions more deeply. The model is trained on open data and cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) materials. You can describe a situation that is causing you distress, or simply share your thoughts in a free-form way. The algorithm will process your text and provide insights that will help you better understand yourself and what’s happening inside. You can view an example analysis by tapping the button below. Text for analysis: I feel like everyone sees me as a failure. I made a mistake at work today, and my boss asked me to fix it. His tone seemed cold and judgmental, as if he truly thinks I’m a failure.

passes.reason: Translation A is more concise and natural for a modern app interface. It avoids the slightly wordy constructions found in B (e.g., 'in a free-form way' vs 'in free form') and uses a more direct, user-friendly imperative for the button instruction.

issues.note: The phrasing 'in a free-form way' is slightly more clunky than 'in free form'. 'You can view an example analysis by tapping...' is more passive/wordy than the direct 'Tap the button below...' used in A.

passes.reason: Translation A is more natural and follows the UX guidelines perfectly, especially with the use of 'tapping' for mobile interaction and a smoother flow in the narrative. Translation B feels slightly more clunky due to the compound 'journal-analysis algorithm' and a less idiomatic 'highlight insights'.

issues.note: The phrase 'journal-analysis algorithm' is a bit heavy/clunky compared to A's more natural phrasing.
The phrasing 'highlight insights' is slightly less idiomatic than 'provide insights' in this context.

en.ru:
Наша команда разработала уникальный алгоритм для анализа записей. ИИ изучит вашу ситуацию, поможет взглянуть на неё с другой стороны и даст полезные рекомендации в рамках КПТ.

Опишите не только события, но и подробно раскройте свои эмоции и мысли. Помните, что качество анализа напрямую зависит от качества вашей записи.

Старайтесь описывать одну конкретную ситуацию или мысль. Если за день произошло несколько событий, лучше создавайте для них отдельные записи и анализируйте каждую по отдельности.
en.oldText:
Our team has created a unique algorithm that analyzes your entries. The AI looks at your situation from different angles and offers helpful CBT-based recommendations.

Describe not only what happened, but also your emotions and thoughts in detail. Remember: the clearer your entry is, the more accurate and useful the analysis will be.

Try to focus on one specific situation or thought at a time. If several important things happened during the day, it’s better to create separate entries so you can analyze each one individually.

Describe not only the events but also go into detail about your emotions and thoughts. Remember that the quality of the analysis depends on the detail in your entry.

Try to describe one specific situation or thought. If several events occur during the day, it’s better to create separate entries for them and analyze each one individually.

issues.note: The phrasing 'the quality of the analysis depends on the detail in your entry' is a bit heavy and sounds like a direct translation of the Russian structure.

en.ru:
Наша команда создала уникальный алгоритм анализа записей дневника, который помогает вам глубже понять свои мысли и эмоции. Модель обучена на открытых данных и материалах по когнитивно-поведенческой терапии (КПТ).

Ниже вы найдёте несколько рекомендаций, которые помогут улучшить качество анализа ваших записей:

Описывайте не только события, но и свои эмоции и мысли по поводу происходящего. Помните: чем точнее и детальнее запись, тем полезнее будет анализ.

Старайтесь фокусироваться на одной конкретной ситуации или мысли. Если в течение дня случилось несколько значимых событий, удобнее создать отдельные записи для каждого из них.

Алгоритм помогает находить иррациональные и деструктивные установки, но не стесняйтесь также отмечать позитивные моменты — это важно для баланса и развития.
en.oldText:
Our team has created a unique diary-analysis algorithm that helps you better understand your thoughts and emotions. It is trained on open data and materials based on cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT).

Below are a few tips to help improve the quality of the analysis of your entries:

Describe not only events, but also your emotions and thoughts about what happened. Remember: the more specific and detailed your entry is, the more helpful the analysis will be.

Try to focus on one specific situation or thought. If several important things happened during the day, it’s better to create a separate entry for each one.

The algorithm helps identify irrational and unhelpful beliefs, but don’t hesitate to note positive moments too — they are just as important for balance and growth.
en.newText:
Our team has created a unique algorithm to analyze your journal entries, helping you understand your thoughts and emotions more deeply. The model is trained on open data and cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) materials.

Here are a few tips to help you get the most out of your analysis:

Describe not only the events but also your emotions and thoughts about what happened. Remember: the more detailed your entry, the more helpful the analysis will be.

Try to focus on one specific situation or thought. If several significant events happen during the day, it’s easier to create separate entries for each of them.

The algorithm helps identify unhelpful beliefs, but don’t hesitate to also note positive moments — this is important for balance and growth.

en.ru:
Старайтесь отличать конструктивный комментарий о работе от оценки личности. Возможно, начальник просто обратил внимание на задачу, и это естественная часть рабочего процесса.

Вспомните свои прошлые успехи и моменты, когда вы хорошо справлялись с задачами. Это поможет увидеть ситуацию шире и не делать выводов на основе одного эпизода.

Работайте над поддержкой собственной самооценки. Чем увереннее вы себя чувствуете, тем легче воспринимать рабочие замечания без ощущения личной критики.
en.oldText:
Try to separate a constructive comment about your work from a judgment of you as a person. It may be that your manager simply pointed out something that needed to be corrected in the task — and that is a natural part of the work process.

Remind yourself of your past successes and situations where you handled tasks well. This helps you see the situation in perspective and not draw conclusions about yourself based on a single episode.

Focus on strengthening your self-esteem. The more confident you feel, the easier it is to receive work-related feedback without experiencing it as personal criticism.
en.newText:
Try to distinguish constructive feedback about your work from a judgment of your personality. It’s possible your boss was simply focusing on the task, which is a natural part of the work process.

Recall your past successes and moments when you handled tasks well. This will help you see the situation more broadly and avoid drawing conclusions based on a single episode.

Work on building your self-esteem. The more confident you feel, the easier it will be to take feedback without feeling like it is a personal criticism.

Анализ сновидений может помочь мягко прикоснуться к глубинным переживаниям и убеждениям, которые не всегда легко осознать в повседневной жизни.

Наша AI-модель проанализирует ваше сновидение, опираясь на классические принципы интерпретации, и предложит гипотезы, которые могут помочь лучше понять внутренние процессы и поддержать вашу работу с техниками когнитивной психологии.

Dream analysis can gently tap into deeper experiences and beliefs that are not always easy to notice in everyday life.

Our AI model will analyse your dream using classic principles of interpretation and suggest hypotheses that can help you better understand your inner processes and support your work with cognitive and CBT-based techniques.
